head: ġfl (< Arab. ġfl (II) cf. Wehr 920-921: nachlässig, sorglos machen; ġfl (III): die Unachtsamkeit j-s benutzen)

senses.gloss: Acht nicht geben; по единственному примеру значение, скорее = значению III ар. породы (см. выше)

stems.sensesRaw: Acht nicht geben; по единственному примеру значение, скорее = значению III ар. породы (см. выше)

examples.turoyo: hedi mlele ʕebe ṭlawḥe w mġafele i=taḥolo, w nafəq b-u=tarʕo-da w azzé
examples.translation: He cautiously filled [his] pockets with lentils and taking advantage of aunt’s inattention passed the gate and left
examples.raw: hedi mlele ʕebe ṭlawḥe w mġafele i=taḥolo, w nafəq b-u=tarʕo-da w azzé ʻHe cautiously filled [his] pockets with lentils and taking advantage of aunt’s inattention passed the gate and leftʼ; 307; 44/72;

examples.turoyo: Ya Moryo lo mġaflatli mu darbayḏux.
examples.translation: Oh Lord! Do not allow me to forget your way.
examples.raw: Ya Moryo lo mġaflatli mu darbayḏux. Oh Lord! Do not allow me to forget your way. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Lu qaṭolo mġafele aʕ ʕasekәr w mahzamle.
examples.translation: The killer cheated the soldiers and escaped
examples.raw: Lu qaṭolo mġafele aʕ ʕasekәr w mahzamle.The killer cheated the soldiers and escaped (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Hoool dәmġaflila, ḥašša, hul dhawyo ... (hátuste xud aḥunoni) ... hawyo b̥ṭaʕno.
examples.translation: Until they she made them inattentive, pardon, until she became… (you are like my brothers)… she became pregnant. NE_DF/16
examples.raw: Hoool dәmġaflila, ḥašša, hul dhawyo ... (hátuste xud aḥunoni) ... hawyo b̥ṭaʕno. Until they she made them inattentive, pardon, until she became… (you are like my brothers)… she became pregnant. NE_DF/16

examples.turoyo: U ruʕyo mġafal mu qaṭʕo w u dewo qṭile aʕ ʕeze kulle.
examples.raw: U ruʕyo mġafal mu qaṭʕo w u dewo qṭile aʕ ʕeze kulle. (İlyas p.c)
